claim.quote: Within the context of the standard halo model, the 90\% C.L. allowed regions implied by the DAMA/LIBRA and CoGeNT AM-based analysis are excluded at $>$99.99\% and 98\% C.L., respectively.

name: Search for Light Weakly-Interacting-Massive-Particle Dark Matter by Annual Modulation Analysis with a Point-Contact Germanium Detector at the China Jinping Underground Laboratory

summary.plain: CDEX-1B looked for the yearly modulation that DAMA/LIBRA and CoGeNT reported and, within the standard dark matter halo model, excluded the regions those signals imply.
summary.technical: 3.2 yr live time within a 4.2 yr span, 1 kg p-type point-contact germanium detector, analysis threshold 250 eVee; the abstract states the best sensitivity at m_chi < 6 GeV/c^2 among WIMP annual-modulation measurements to date.

title: Search for Light Weakly-Interacting-Massive-Particle Dark Matter by Annual Modulation Analysis with a Point-Contact Germanium Detector at the China Jinping Underground Laboratory
why_it_matters: A direct germanium test of the DAMA/LIBRA and CoGeNT annual-modulation interpretations.
